newsitem.title: CHILE: Saved by a pen, policeman is killed by a tree.
newsitem.headline: Saved by a pen, policeman is killed by a tree.

text.p: A Chilean policeman who averted death last year when a bank robber's bullet ricocheted off a pen in his breast pocket died when a tree fell on his squad car.
Hector Zapata Cuevas was crushed when the big eucalyptus crashed onto the car during a rainstorm late Tuesday in the Santiago suburb of Penaflor, police said on Wednesday.
He was behind the wheel and was responding to an emergency call with two colleagues, who were slightly injured.
Zapata, 33, became a celebrity in Chile last November when a bullet fired by a fleeing bank robber bounced off the pen in his pocket, leaving him unscathed except for an ink stain on his shirt.
He was married but had no children, a colleague in Penaflor told Reuters.
